runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the payload pointer at +0x08 and the two lead pointers at +0x14 and +0x18
0x00401020 and 0x005f0a60 are dependency-only ports, so the unregister is unverified in this package
the vtable slot one and the vtable slot 0x108 owners are unresolved
the second release is unconditional, so a null lead at +0x18 is not special-cased and the slot 0x108 dispatch is guarded only by the null test

the decompilation passes the receiver to the slot 0x108 dispatch; the assembly passes the lead at +0x18 and the address of the host payload at +0x08, so the model keeps the two argument shape
